TRT01P = ARM (planned arm). Null for screen failures (reason in ARMNRS).
TRT01A = ACTARM (actual arm). Null for screen failures.
TRT01PN, TRT01AN: Placebo 0, Xanomeline Low Dose 54, Xanomeline High Dose 81 (patch dose in mg, as in P1).
Date part of DS.DSSTDTC where DS.DSDECOD = RANDOMIZED. Null for screen failures.
Date part of DM.RFXSTDTC. Equals RANDDT for all randomized subjects.
Date part of DM.RFXENDTC; if null, date part of DM.RFENDTC.
"Y" if the subject has a DS record with DSDECOD = RANDOMIZED, else "N". 254 subjects.
"Y" if ITTFL = "Y" and the subject has at least one EX record, else "N".
Latest complete date (10 characters or more) among SV.SVSTDTC, SV.SVENDTC, EX.EXSTDTC, EX.EXENDTC, TR.TRDTC, RS.RSDTC, DS.DSSTDTC (DSDECOD not DEATH) and DM.RFXSTDTC. Partial dates are not used.

From the DS record with DSCAT = DISPOSITION EVENT (one per subject). EOSSTT = COMPLETED if DSDECOD = COMPLETED, else DISCONTINUED. EOSDT = date part of DSSTDTC. DCSREAS = DSDECOD when EOSSTT = DISCONTINUED. Screen failures: DISCONTINUED, SCREEN FAILURE.
PARAMCD, PARAM, PARAMN from codelists PARAMRS and PARAMRSN: OVR 1, PD 2, BOR 3, RSP 4.

One record per RS record with RSTESTCD = OVRLRESP, RSACPTFL = "Y" (Radiologist 1) and non-null RSORRES, for ITTFL = "Y". AVALC = RSORRES. ADT = date part of RSDTC. AVISIT = VISIT, AVISITN = VISITNUM. SRCDOM = RS, SRCVAR = RSORRES, SRCSEQ = RSSEQ.
AVAL from AVALC for OVR and BOR: CR 1, PR 2, SD 3, NON-CR/NON-PD 4, PD 5, NE 6, MISSING 7. PD and RSP: Y 1, N 0.
ADT - TRTSDT + 1 if ADT >= TRTSDT, else ADT - TRTSDT. Null when ADT is null.
Running number within USUBJID, ordered by PARAMN, ADT.
"Y" on OVR records with ADT on or before the first PD date of the subject (all OVR records when there is no PD). Null on later OVR records and on other parameters.
One record for each subject with an OVR record of AVALC = PD: the earliest such record. AVALC = "Y", AVAL = 1. ADT, AVISIT, AVISITN, SRC variables from that record.

One record per ITT subject, unconfirmed. Uses OVR records with ANL01FL = "Y". Best response in the order CR, PR, SD, PD, NE: CR or PR if any; SD only if a record has ADY >= 42, else that record counts as NE; PD if any PD; NE if only NE; MISSING if the subject has no OVR record. ADT, AVISIT, AVISITN and SRC variables come from the earliest OVR record with the best response (for NE the earliest SD record before day 42); null for MISSING.
One record per BOR record. AVALC = "Y" (AVAL 1) if BOR is CR or PR, else "N" (AVAL 0). ADT and visit from the BOR record.
OVR, PD, BOR, RSP: SRCDOM = RS, SRCVAR = RSORRES, SRCSEQ = RSSEQ of the record the value comes from. Null for BOR = MISSING.
PARAMCD, PARAM, PARAMN from codelists PARAMTTE and PARAMTTEN: PFS 1, OS 2. One record per ITT subject and parameter.

PFS: event is the earlier of the ADRS PD date and ADSL.DTHDT (any cause); on the same date PROGRESSIVE DISEASE is used. CNSR 0, EVNTDESC PROGRESSIVE DISEASE or DEATH. Censored: ADT = latest ADRS OVR date with ANL01FL = "Y" (CNSDTDSC LAST TUMOR ASSESSMENT), or STARTDT when the subject has none (RANDOMIZATION). OS: event is ADSL.DTHDT (EVNTDESC DEATH); censored at ADSL.LSTALVDT (LAST KNOWN ALIVE DATE). CNSR 1 when censored. SRCDOM/SRCVAR: RS/RSORRES for PD, DM/DTHDTC for death, RS/RSDTC for last tumor assessment, ADSL/LSTALVDT, ADSL/RANDDT.
ADSL has all 306 screened subjects, including 52 screen failures (ITTFL = N). Analysis populations: ITT = randomized (254), safety = randomized with at least one EX record.
DM.RFXENDTC is null for 2 randomized subjects; DM.RFENDTC is used.

Each tumor assessment is recorded by the investigator and by two independent radiologists. ADRS uses the records with RSACPTFL = "Y" (Radiologist 1). Radiologist 2 and the investigator are not analyzed.
AVALC/AVAL meaning depends on PARAMCD: OVR and BOR hold the response (see MT.ADRS.AVAL), PD and RSP hold Y/N.
PFS and OS only. Only 3 subjects died, so OS is almost entirely censored. The responses in the source are synthetic and not clinically consistent (see Open Issues).
